name: @eidonze/mcpdoctor
description: CLI for inspecting MCP and x402 endpoints: parses the HTTP 402 payment document (v1/v2 accepts[]), checks /.well-known/mcp and /.well-known/x402 discovery manifests, returns a response SHA-256 digest. Read-only endpoint inspector and preflight debugging tool for AI-agent payment endpoints. Not an MCP server. Zero dependencies.
